## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: aws-verify-live.sh runs all 7 checks from SC10 table and exits 0 only if all pass ← Satisfies: sc-10
- DD2: Each failed check emits a named FAIL: <check-name> line to stderr ← Satisfies: sc-10
- DD3: Script reads resource names from dso-config.conf (not hardcoded) ← Satisfies: sc-10
- DD4: After aws-teardown.sh runs, aws-verify-live.sh exits non-zero with per-check status indicating resources absent, and the end-to-end POST check times out within 5 seconds ← Satisfies: sc-10

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash "$REPO_ROOT/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] Test file contains tests for all 7 check behaviors (Lambda URL, IAM role, S3 head-bucket, S3 encryption, S3 lifecycle, IAM simulate, E2E healthcheck)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Tests confirm exit-0-on-all-pass behavior (given all mocked AWS commands succeed)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_all_checks_pass"
- [ ] Tests confirm exit-nonzero-on-any-fail behavior (given one mocked AWS command fails)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_any_check_fail"
- [ ] Tests confirm FAIL: <check-name> lines emitted to stderr on failure
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_fail_line_format"
- [ ] Tests confirm exit-1 with missing-key message when review_telemetry.* config key absent
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_missing_config_key"
- [ ] Tests confirm E2E POST times out quickly (<=5s) when endpoint unreachable (post-teardown scenario)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_e2e_timeout"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_all_checks_pass] for plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_all_checks_pass\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## TDD Requirement
Write tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh BEFORE implementing the script. Tests must fail (RED) before T2 runs. The test file mocks the `aws` CLI via a PATH-prefix stub directory so no live AWS calls are made. Test scenarios (Given/When/Then):

1. **test_all_checks_pass**: Given all 7 mocked aws commands return 0 with expected output AND config has all review_telemetry.* keys AND mocked curl returns 200, When aws-verify-live.sh runs, Then exit code is 0 and no FAIL: lines on stderr.

2. **test_any_check_fail**: Given check #3 (S3 head-bucket) mocked to return non-zero, When aws-verify-live.sh runs, Then exit code is non-zero AND stderr contains "FAIL: s3-head-bucket".

3. **test_fail_line_format**: Given IAM role check fails, When script runs, Then stderr contains line matching "^FAIL: iam-role".

4. **test_missing_config_key**: Given review_telemetry.lambda_function_name is absent from dso-config.conf, When aws-verify-live.sh runs, Then exit code is 1 AND stdout/stderr contains the missing key name.

5. **test_e2e_timeout**: Given curl to endpoint URL times out quickly (mocked with sleep+exit 1) AND S3 object NOT found, When aws-verify-live.sh runs during E2E check, Then the check exits within 5 seconds (not hung indefinitely).

## Implementation Notes
- Use mktemp to create a temp dir for mock aws/curl stubs: `STUB_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/test-aws-verify-live.XXXXXX)`
- Write stub files in $STUB_DIR/aws and $STUB_DIR/curl; chmod +x; prefix PATH
- Each test resets the stub to control which mock aws call fails
- Source tests/lib/assert.sh for assertion helpers
- Run aws-verify-live.sh as a subprocess: `PATH="$STUB_DIR:$PATH" bash "$SCRIPT" 2>stderr_capture`
- E2E timeout test: stub curl to sleep 10 then exit 1; confirm the test completes within 5s using `timeout 6 bash "$SCRIPT"`

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED test: aws-verify-live.sh — 7-check behavioral test suite with mocked AWS CLI
